steps.action_code:
def password_for_app(app_name):
    matches = [record for record in account_password_records if record["account_name"].strip().casefold() == app_name.casefold()]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one password record for the requested app")
    return matches[0]["password"]

phone_username = supervisor_profile["phone_number"]
phone_password = password_for_app("phone")
venmo_username = supervisor_profile["email"]
venmo_password = password_for_app("venmo")
verification_targets: Exactly one password record is selected for each required app.
